domain: Automotive Fuel Economy and Emissions Data
scenario:
A global automotive research organization is building a comprehensive Vehicle Fuel Economy and Emissions Analysis System. This platform aims to consolidate data on vehicle performance metrics, emissions data, and fuel economy across various makes and models to support regulatory compliance, consumer information, and environmental impact assessments.

The system will store extensive details about each vehicle, including engine specifications, fuel types, vehicle classes, and transmission types. It will also include detailed emissions data, fuel consumption rates, and cost assessments for different fuel types. The platform must support historical data analysis to identify trends in vehicle performance over time and assess improvements in fuel efficiency and emissions reduction.

The organization plans to facilitate advanced analytics and reporting capabilities, enabling researchers and policymakers to evaluate the environmental impact of different vehicle technologies. Furthermore, the system will provide a robust user management framework, allowing authorized users to access data, generate reports, and conduct in-depth analyses.

The system must also support integration with other automotive databases and regulatory systems to streamline data sharing and ensure compliance with international standards. Additionally, it will feature ultra-wide tables to accommodate the diverse range of vehicle attributes and performance metrics required for comprehensive analysis.
